acceptance.api: Synthetic fit/update/save/load, causality, arbitrary command dimensions, rotation/shape contracts, immutable revisions and corruption rejection; installed wheel exercised outside checkout.
acceptance.artifact_protection: Before deletion, preserve small independent baseline pack containing models, input/output regression records, original qualification/readout summaries and source identities; hash-check exported data. Keep raw relevant recordings and evaluation truth needed for next work. Preserve latest milestone full proof compressed if reasonably sized. No deletion of user external Dart/simulator assets.
acceptance.dart: Exact dtype/shape/value equality for all40 selected means and all4144 recorded actual objective/gradient callbacks using saved histories/proposals and unchanged Dart objective; no optimizer invocation. Canonical contact reconstructed from retained native trajectory agrees.
acceptance.deletion: Inventory exact project-owned artifact/worktree paths; remove only after new portable regressions and package tests pass. Do not delete dirty worktrees, external repositories or unrelated files. Old committed source/history remains in Git.
acceptance.flights: Exact equality for all saved supported prediction arrays on both frozen Crazyflow/Cascade cohorts; preserve missing-input/failure eligibility.
acceptance.models: All3 saved supported cores retain identical numeric arrays and core fingerprints under public packaging. Envelope evidence may not be claimed for uncalibrated migrated core-only models.
acceptance.report: Record before/after counts and disk usage, exact deletion ledger, adoption decision, results and remaining scientific gaps. Every prior negative finding remains a limitation, not automatically a veto on user adoption.
acceptance.source: One learner implementation; no dynamic external source imports or family selector; public fit/predict/update has no tuning flags.

decision: Explicit user adoption of supported shared-physics model as the single maintained/public implementation. Policy on known evidence, not a changed historical acceptance verdict or universal adequacy claim.
named_gap: Lean single supported learner; eliminate superseded implementations, interfaces, experiments and their artifacts.

keep: one supported shared-physics inference and fixed fitting recipe
recordings, fingerprinted save/load and immutable update
generic motion geometry actually used by Dart
minimal fit/evaluate CLI and generic recording IO
small active tests and portable saved baseline evidence
no_changes: supported inference mathematics, fitted parameters, normalization and time contracts
Dart controller, mission criteria and simulator sources
remove: public v4 and other learner alternatives
experimental package and one-off investigation scripts
obsolete docs/tests/results and redundant experiment artifacts
retired clean experiment worktrees after preservation verification
scope.scientific_work: No long fits, new optimization/controller trial, hyperparameter searches or native simulator evaluations. Export saved inputs/outputs and compare new implementation on them. Analytic small fit/update tests allowed. No retry of old stages.
